# Complex fixture provenance

This directory is a **verbatim snapshot** of the Apache Commons CLI
project, used as the *complex-tier* fixture for the
`@reponova/lang-java` extractor tests. No file was modified — the
upstream `LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` are reproduced under their
canonical names (`LICENSE` and `NOTICE`).

## Upstream

- Project: [Apache Commons CLI](https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-cli/)
- Repository: <https://github.com/apache/commons-cli>
- Release tag: `rel/commons-cli-1.9.0`
- Commit SHA: `698b238276c0e22e97e4aec703a0b00201d29666`
- Snapshot date (upstream tag): 2024-08-14

## Files snapshotted

`src/main/java/org/apache/commons/cli/*.java` (26 files, ~239 KB total),
plus the upstream `LICENSE.txt` (renamed to `LICENSE`) and
`NOTICE.txt` (renamed to `NOTICE`).

## License

Apache License 2.0 — see `LICENSE`. Per ASF policy, the `NOTICE` file
must be redistributed alongside any derived works. RepoNova does not
redistribute Commons CLI; this snapshot exists solely as test input
for the Java language-plugin tests.
